title: BossBound Relics [drops & weapons]
description: New weapons as a reward for beating bosses !
body:
Already 1.4k downloads on CurseForge, join the adventure !


New updates planned:

- Enhancing mini-bosses by providing them some new related weapons as a reward

- A new weapon related to the evoker

- Some fixes and improvements

- Might make illusionner spawning naturally in mansions 



 

                                                      ---1.21.8 Released!---

 

In the aim of making minecraft vanilla better I'm doing some mods and resource packs with vanilla-like content.

 

BossBound Relics introduce some new legendary weapons as a reward for defeating bosses !

- You'll have to use bosses' breaths to craft those weapons

- Some already exists, some are added by the mod

 

This mod adds 3 new weapons yet, every of each makes you able to feel like you became a boss :

- Every weapon's crafts require a smithing template 

- The Dragon Fire Sword is craftable by merging a netherite sword and a dragon's breath together 

- The Echo Bow requires to merge a bow and a warden's breath, which has 1/3 chance to be dropped

- The CrossSkull requires to merge a crossbow and a wither's breath, craftable in a brewing stand

- The Shieldian requires to merge a shield and a guardian's breath, dropped after killing 3 elder guardians

(examples in media)
